description: MIRA SourceDocument — a paper/book/preprint that reports evidence. Maps mira.yaml class SourceDocument (is_a schema:CreativeWork; mixin NodeSchema). DRAFT.

main.description: A source document. 'externalRecord' is the ecosystem-interop seam: it can point at a richer document record in another lexicon (e.g. pub.oxa.document) that represents the same work.

attributedTo.description: MIRA creator of the record (the curator), when it differs from the signing repo DID. Document authorship is in 'authors'.

authors.description: Document authors (distinct from the MIRA record creator).

describesActivity.description: MIRA describesActivity — Studies/Activities this document reports.

externalRecord.description: Interop seam — AT-URI of a richer record for this same work in another lexicon (e.g. pub.oxa.document).
